verdict.comment: The stylish manner in which FAMOUS CLERMONT ran away with this race two years ago is by no means a faded memory. He has his ground.

comments.ajetofourown: Unable to lay a glove on Joker De Mai at Taunton last month; very opposable
comments.annamix: Poor last time but has a good record over these fences so can't be dismissed
comments.autonomouscloud: Second to Bennys King last time and he needs slower ground at this sort of trip
comments.bardenstownlad: At 66-1 he offered little in the hunter chase at Cheltenham last month
comments.bennysking: Runner-up in this for the last two years and got his head back in front last time out
comments.bothwellbridge: Held by Bennys King and Autonomous Cloud on their Leicester clash in February
comments.captaintommy: Ran at Kempton on Tuesday when remote second behind a runaway winner; non-runner.
comments.dorkingcock: 33-1 when never a factor in this two years ago and a similar scenario seems likely
comments.evasoskar: Formerly smart but he'll need to find plenty on his recent hunter chase exploits
comments.famousclermont: Ran out a comfortable winner of this two years ago and everything again looks ideal
comments.fixatall: Others have more impressive CVs and he made a quiet stable debut
comments.freredarmes: Recent defeats at the hands of Bardenstown Lad and Captain Tommy do not bode well
comments.gogogeronimo: His fifth defeat in hunter chases when beaten in a small field at Fakenham 20 days ago
comments.gracchusdebalme: Poor last time but a repeat of his Haydock second would see him competitive
comments.jetplane: Behind My Drogo at Haydock where a late mistake didn't cost him the race
comments.jokerdemai: Recent win was over 2m and others will probably be stronger stayers at this distance
comments.lifetimeambition: Classy operator who has form over these fences and won his last two points easily
comments.mastertemplar: This demands a career best by some margin; blinkers replace cheekpieces
comments.milanforth: Made it 2-2 in hunter chases last time at Down Royal and this 6yo could be improving
comments.mydrogo: Grade 1-winning hurdler and rolled back the years with recent hunter chase win at Haydock
comments.ontheropes: Even Cheltenham's extended 3m2f seemed too sharp a test last month
comments.percussion: He has form figures of 33237 in handicaps over the Grand National fences
comments.presentandcounting: Beaten in recent hunter chases won by Bardenstown Lad and Captain Tommy
comments.pyleighcourt: There's nothing on his CV that entitles him to trouble the best of these
comments.ramillies: Has a modest rules strike-rate for one of his ability and looks a declining force
comments.seniorcitizen: Placed in a Grand Sefton and a Topham; easily won his latest point; could play a part
comments.willewonga: On the balance of this season's form he has no more than place aspirations
comments.willitgoahead: Fast-improving 7yo who stayed on well to reach the frame at Cheltenham last month
comments.yccsportocervo: Knows how to win but he's still well down the pecking order in a race this competitive
comments.yippeekiyay: Won two hunter chases last year but those wins were in much easier races

races.raceComment: famousclermont is marginally preferred with a score of 67.6%, holding clear edges in stronger recent form over bennysking. Won 2 of last 3 starts. Ground (Good To Soft) looks ideal with 13 wins from 23 starts in similar conditions. Strong pace likely with multiple front-runners. Excellent course form of 14/27 at aintree. Key attributes include excellent form and optimal distance and strong course form and improving.

verdict.comment: The change in ground conditions will catch out a few but not MY MATE MOZZIE who ran another excellent race at Cheltenham last month.

comments.calico: Good 2m win in October; drying ground will suit; highish mark for this competitive a race
comments.drtjeckleburg: In good heart over the winter but best on soft/heavy ground, so surface switch is a worry
comments.galunggung: Excellent rules strike-rate but quicker conditions and rise in class ask some questions
comments.generalmedrano: Quite progressive at about 2m until no real impact at Cheltenham latest; left on same mark
comments.gunsightridge: C&D winner in 2022; back to form with 1m7f win latest; another career-high mark today
comments.huntersyarn: Impressive in 2m1f beginners chase last January; injured on latest; interesting if at best
comments.ineditstar: Some fair chase and hurdle runs in Britain; bled from the nose in January on latest outing
comments.mymatemozzie: Involved in strong events on the Flat, over hurdles and fences since last summer; solid
comments.petittonnerre: Has run well in handicaps over hurdles and fences here; back to form on latest completion
comments.primoz: Quickly made up into useful chaser before suffering from start problems at Cheltenham
comments.rathgaulhill: Progressive; narrow 2m winner at Newbury but might come on for the run and do better yet
comments.sansbruit: Front-running win in this last year off this mark; disappointing of late; revival possible
comments.thefolkestiara: In fine form in warm Irish handicaps; yard won this twice in the last 5 years; respected
comments.tommysoscar: Suited by a sharp 2m; back on latest winning mark; prefers good to soft or slower ground

races.raceComment: tommysoscar is marginally preferred with a score of 61.6%, holding clear edges in better ratings and more progressive over drtjeckleburg. Won 1 of last 6 starts. Ground (Good To Soft) looks ideal with 13 wins from 33 starts in similar conditions. Excellent course form of 13/37 at aintree. Key attributes include optimal distance and improving, though inconsistent profile need consideration.

verdict.comment: This can go to NIGHT ARC, who has slipped in the weights and ran well last time. He's worth another go over this trip.

comments.balqaa: Bit below best on last two starts but couldn't rule out back up in trip
comments.crackingfilly: Regressive maiden; has shown ability over C&D but needs to raise game to win this
comments.cryptosdream: Running respectably of late but needs to raise game again if she's to win this
comments.dubaiimmo: Won over C&D and over 1m6f at Wolverhampton last year; form patchy since
comments.foinix: Running respectably of late; back in trip from wide draw
comments.foresthaze: First run for new trainer and no surprise should she be able to raise her game
comments.globalresolve: Best effort came over C&D but he's a regressive maiden who has something to prove
comments.hijodelaluna: 2lb ahead of his mark judged on latest Newcastle form but yet to win after 20 Flat starts
comments.itstim: Respectable effort on handicap debut last time; bred to stay 1m2f and may do better
comments.nightarc: Not won since 2023 but shaped as though coming to hand last time; player back up in trip
comments.oyamal: Has run well over C&D but well beaten on last five starts and easy enough to take on
comments.stintinosunset: C&D winner and a reliable type; hasn't been seen since November but should go well
comments.tacticalcontrol: Running well of late but has an ordinary strike-rate and drawn wide back up in trip

races.raceComment: dubaiimmo is marginally preferred with a score of 49.1%. Won 1 of last 6 starts, though returning from absence and unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.
